difficulty_reason: For a Noetherian algebraic space X, quasi-coherent ideal I, and coherent modules F, G with H = SheafHom(F, G), the lemma identifies the morphism set Mor_{Coh(X,I)}(F-hat, G-hat) of the formal category with the limit of H^0(X, H / I^n H) — internal Hom computes morphisms in the I-adic formal world. The retained proof is written: H and the quotient systems live on the etale site, and objects/morphisms of Coh(X, I) satisfy etale descent (the chapter's formal-categories comparison facts), so the identity can be checked etale locally on X; on a scheme chart it is the schemes theorem Cohomology of Schemes, lemma completion-internal-hom. Retained author proof at lines 9669-9675.
